scope: One selected renderer-failure mutation and two selected legacy cleanup-ownership mutations. This is a focused check, not project-wide mutation coverage.
classification_method: Independent inspection of every completed browser log, reconstruction of each single-line source mutation and verification of its SHA-256 against both the header and Production sources output.
source_binding: The logging wrapper sets ALASHI_TEST_FRONTEND_ROOT to the current checkout or mutation overlay. The runner resolves production harness imports into that root, verifies source hashes in its Vite transform hook, and asserts that the selected production module was loaded before printing RESULT. Shared test-runner or renderer-adapter paths do not select the production source.
expected_renderer_error: Finding 6 intentionally throws inside its renderer adapter. The React error boundary catches it in both baseline and mutant. The mutant is classified by the later vote-versus-idle assertion, not by that expected error message.
